title: Concept: R package whose project URL is cleartext
description: DESCRIPTION declares a `URL` field over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `URL` field over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through DESCRIPTION (cran).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `URL` field over cleartext.
